entry.title: Checkpoint composition does not yet fold group verdicts with the verdict semigroup
entry.why: Card W45-AUDIT-CHECKPOINTS, running concurrently, adds `.qo` checkpoints with divide-and-conquer composition. Language spec §L21.2 states that a group verdict over checkpoints composes with the same join, and `qcore_schemas::verdict` exposes it (`Verdict::fold`, `ReasonedVerdict::fold`, `Chain` with `ChainKind::UnitGroup`); this card did not edit the checkpoint modules. DISCHARGE: the checkpoint compose calls `qcore_schemas::verdict` for every group verdict, with a test that a composed group equals the fold of its members' verdicts and that a `Pending` member keeps the group from `Safe`.

ground: Its discharge condition: "the checkpoint compose calls `qcore_schemas::verdict` for every group verdict, with a test that a composed group equals the fold of its members' verdicts and that a `Pending` member keeps the group from `Safe`". Each `.qo` result section now records its group's verdict as `Verdict::fold` of its units' verdicts (`checkpoint::unit_verdict`), and `compose::fold_verdicts` joins the group verdicts with `Verdict::join` (`Safe` the identity) into the run verdict, refusing a group whose recorded verdict disagrees with the verdict its tallies imply. Tests: `compose::tests::a_composed_verdict_is_the_fold_of_its_members` (every two-way split of a unit list folds to the whole list's verdict; a `Pending` member keeps a group from `Safe`), `a_group_whose_verdict_disagrees_with_its_tallies_is_refused`, and the fixture test `a_re_pin_invalidates_every_checkpoint` (unlocked pinned contracts make units `Pending`; the group's and the run's verdicts are the folds of the whole run's unit statuses). Composition stays byte-identical to the whole run (report, section 6).
